summary: Streamex Corp. filed an 8-K to announce the appointment of Kori Handy as Vice President of Product and Design. The filing includes a press release detailing her background at Microsoft, PayPal, and other firms. No transaction, shareholder vote, or strategic event is described. This is a routine executive hire, not a forced departure or transformative change. The filing falls under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and consists solely of a leadership addition. Absent any special-situation criteria, this is classified as a routine current report.
